explanation: OEIS A129365, conjecture D: with b = A004125 (b(n) = Σ_{k≤n} n mod k), ordp(a(np), p) = b(n) + b(⌊n/p⌋) + b(⌊n/p²⌋) + …. The formal b is A004125, and the statement is padicValRat p (a(np)) = Σ_{i≥0} b(⌊n/p^i⌋) as an integer tsum (only finitely many nonzero terms, since b(0) = 0). Faithful.
